operation_details.item: The user uses Notion for article outlines.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How’s your writing workflow looking today?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Pretty organized so far. I’m getting an article outline ready before I start drafting.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Nice. What are you using to map out the outline?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I use Notion for my article outlines. It makes it easy to rearrange sections and keep notes nearby.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That sounds handy, especially when the structure is still taking shape. Do you move the draft into another tool afterward?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, I use Scrivener for long-form drafts, then Google Docs when I need collaborative edits.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That’s a practical division of labor. How do you keep the voice consistent across projects?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I keep a shared style guide for all projects, so everyone has the same reference point.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Please forget only that I use Notion for outlines, while keeping the other tools and the style guide.
